relationships.subject: MMP-9
relationships.evidence_quote: MMP-9 has been shown to digest this protein, releasing it from the joint space.

relationships.subject: IL-6
relationships.evidence_quote: Pro-inflammatory biomarkers upregulate MMP-9 and downregulate PRG4, leading to cartilage degradation and decreased protection for the joint.

key_findings: Plasma MMP-9 was significantly higher in OA patients undergoing arthroplasty than controls at all time points (1270 vs 77.4 ng/mL)
MMP-9, IL-6, CRP and WBC peaked at day 1 post-operatively; PRG4 was not significantly different from controls
